request.prompt:
Goods: Raw cane sugar in bulk
Country of origin: BR

Chosen so far: 17 Sugars and sugar confectionery > 1701 Cane or beet sugar and chemically pure sucrose, in solid form

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 170113: Sugars; cane sugar, raw, in solid form, as specified in Subheading Note 2 to this chapter, not containing added flavouring or colouring matter
- 170114: Sugars; cane sugar, raw, in solid form, other than as specified in Subheading Note 2 to this chapter, not containing added flavouring or colouring matter
- 170112: Sugars; beet sugar, raw, in solid form, not containing added flavouring or colouring matter
- 170199: Sugars; sucrose, chemically pure, in solid form, not containing added flavouring or colouring matter
- 170191: Sugars; sucrose, chemically pure, in solid form, containing added flavouring or colouring matter

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Raw cane sugar in solid form falls under 170113 or 170114 depending on Subheading Note 2 (polarisation of 69° to under 93° and no other qualifying characteristics for 170113 versus other), and since no polarisation is given, the default for typical Brazilian raw sugar (VHP, ~99° polarisation) is 170114.5 Note 2 covers only sugar with polarisation under 93°, so higher-polarisation raw sugar is 170114.}}
